environment.cache_type: in-memory PubMed/hybrid cache plus project LLM response cache

interpretation: The observed warm requests reused the PubMed hybrid result and were substantially faster; the answer cache was also hit.
limitations: These are local observed timings, not a controlled benchmark.
Cold-start time depends on PubMed network latency and embedding model loading.
The result does not measure full PubMed-corpus recall.
